title: Smoking Rooms in Buildings and Restrictions against Those who Smoke on the Move
what_it_is: Smoking Rooms in Buildings and Restrictions against Those who Smoke on the Move

sections.label: Smoking prevalence and deaths
sections.summary: Smoking prevalence has hovered around 12%-14% over the last decade, and an average of six Singaporeans die prematurely daily from smoking-related diseases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the last decade, the prevalence of smoking has hovered around 12%-14%, and an average of six Singaporeans die prematurely from smoking-related diseases each day.

sections.label: No mandate for smoking rooms
sections.summary: With smoking already disallowed in most buildings with public access, the Government has no plans to mandate smoking rooms in such premises.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With smoking already disallowed in most buildings with public access, the Government has no plans to mandate the provision of smoking rooms in such premises.

sections.label: Orchard Road smoke-free zone
sections.summary: Later this year the Orchard Road precinct will be gazetted a smoke-free zone, with smoking banned in public areas except at designated smoking areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the latter part of this year, the Orchard Road precinct will be gazetted as a smoke-free zone where smoking will no longer be allowed at all in public areas, except at a number of DSAs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This means that smokers will not be able to light up while walking within the zone.

sections.label: Evaluating DSA study results
sections.summary: The Member's suggestion is thanked, and the study results are being evaluated and will be considered when deciding future plans for DSAs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I want to thank the Member for her suggestion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are evaluating the results of this study and the results will be taken into consideration when we decide on the future plans for DSAs.

sections.label: ETS health risk and smoking rooms
sections.summary: ETS could seep into other parts of a building and pose a health risk, so smoking rooms are allowed only in certain premises under strict requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This ETS could seep into other parts of the building and it could pose a health hazard and a health risk to persons in the enclosed space.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: That is the reason why under the Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Act, we only allow smoking rooms in certain publicly accessible areas or premises, such as at Changi Airport Terminals' transit area, as well as in pubs, discotheques and so on, and also in office premises, but subject to very strict requirements.

sections.label: Smoking in homes not prohibited
sections.summary: Smoking within residential premises and the home is beyond the Government's jurisdiction, and there is no smoking prohibition within homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Smoking within residential premises, in the home, in private space is beyond the jurisdiction of the Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We do not have smoking prohibition within the homes themselves.

sections.label: Orchard Road DSA pilot
sections.summary: The DSAs were piloted in Orchard Road last year because Orchard Road has very high pedestrian traffic.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Are we protecting the tourists or the residents?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We piloted the DSAs in Orchard Road last year because Orchard Road has a very high footfall or pedestrian traffic.

sections.label: Exploring more smoke-free zones
sections.summary: The Government is exploring designating other areas as smoke-free zones to reach its long-term goal of prohibiting smoking in all public areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, we are exploring the feasibility of designating other areas as smoke-free zones in order to achieve the Government's long-term goal of prohibiting smoking in all public areas.
